treeNote: Phases 1-3.2, 4 and 5 were uncommitted in the working tree before Phase 6. The persistence baseline was captured on that same pre-Phase-6 tree with tests/tabContextPersistence.ui.cjs (RESULTS always printed), then the Phase 6 edits were applied in place. No stash/reset/clean/commit/worktree operations were performed.

persistenceBenchmark.harness: tests/fixtures/tabContextPersistence.jsx mounts the REAL TabProvider under an instrumented localStorage: setItem for the tab key is counted (and can be made to throw), and JSON.stringify of payloads containing activeTabId is counted. Counters reset between scenarios.
persistenceBenchmark.headline: Startup writes 1 -> 0; three same-tick updates 3 writes/3 serializes -> 1/1; a status-only change 1 write -> 0; a failed write is retried instead of assumed durable; persistence no longer happens inside the state updater.

strictModeProbe.note: Focused React probe (not left in the repo): under React.StrictMode dev, the component body rendered twice on mount but the useState updater was invoked once per update (mountCalls 0, updateCalls 1). The Phase 6 design does not depend on this: there is no side effect in the updater to duplicate.

renderBenchmark.harness: Real App shell with heavy leaves stubbed to counters (shared tests/fixtures/renderIsolationStubs.cjs). tests/renderIsolation.ui.cjs = Phase 4 baseline; tests/tabSwitchIsolation.ui.cjs = Phase 6 additions.
renderBenchmark.headline: The active-tab transition still renders exactly the two tabs involved plus one required AppContent render (AppContent derives the active tab's model/provider and the active prop). The only render reduction is collapsing an unchanged per-tab update: re-emitting the same status went from 1 tab + AppContent to 0/0, while a genuine status change still propagates 1 tab + AppContent.

changedFiles: src/context/TabContext.jsx (pure commit; persistence in a deduped effect that advances persistedRef only on success; stateRef moved out of the updater; updateTab/markTabSaved/status routing use pure reducers; activateTab no-op; deduped unload backstop)
src/lib/tabState.mjs (new pure updateTabState / updateTabsBySessionState reducers returning the same state for a no-op)
tests/tabPersistence.test.mjs (unit tests for the reducers, no-op collapsing, and that tab mutators never touch localStorage)
tests/renderIsolation.ui.cjs (uses the shared stub plugin; behavior unchanged)
